answer: Resist sybils topologically. The epoch's randomness beacon starts walks at human-verified seeds; influence equals landing frequency, and the protocol caps endorsement links per account per epoch. A farmer mints accounts freely, but his cluster reaches honest ground only across a narrow jetty of granted links: pay tracks bought links, not account count — splitting just divides the same probability. Edges sit in an append-only log, durable as cedar, so fraud stays auditable. Assumes verified seeds, a well-mixed honest core, and few links sold; cheap link markets break it.
